entry.title: 🏖️ Summer Schedule : Open all Summer, slightly longer dispatch times.
entry.content:
Summer is a busy period for pentesters, with Blackhat and DEFCON taking center stage.

Operational Updates

While our warehouse remains fully operational during the summer months, some logistical partners have announced pickup and delivery restrictions due to excessive heat and French public holidays in August.

While the vast majority of orders will dispatch within our standard 24 business hours, some deliveries may take up to 48 business hours to be dispatched.

New Product Announcements

If you're taking a summer break, enjoy your well earned holidays. Many new products have been announced at DEFCON and BlackHat, and we'll be announcing new products and packs in the coming weeks!

The Lab401 Team

entry.title: November 22: Warehouse closed : shipping resumes November 23.
entry.content:
In order to prepare for Black Friday / Cyber Monday sales, there will be no shipments on November 22.

All shipments will resume November 23.

Stay tuned for our Black Friday / Cyber Monday announcement, which will be announced on the morning of Friday, November 24.
